title: 丁仲礼会见中法市长圆桌会议2026双方代表

title_en: Reviewing the Old and Creating the New; Enduring Friendship
summary: 文章缅怀日本前首相福田康夫逝世，回顾作者任人民日报驻日记者期间与其交往。福田长期心系中日友好，在首相任内推动签署《中日关于全面推进战略互惠关系的联合声明》，强调恪守中日四个政治文件。他正视历史，主张日本直面侵略战争教训，认同人类命运共同体理
summary_en: An article mourns former Japanese Prime Minister Yasuo Fukuda and recalls the author's interactions with him as a People's Daily correspondent in Japan; it highlights Fukuda's commitment to China-Japan friendship, promotion of the China-Japan Joint Statement on Comprehensively Advancing Strategic and Reciprocal Relations, adherence to the four China-Japan political documents, and his call for Japan to face its history of aggression and embrace the vision of a community with a shared future for mankind.

summary_en: The 2026 China-Chile Human Rights Seminar was held in Santiago, Chile, on the 4th, themed 'China-Chile Mutual Learning and Common Development - Commemorating the 40th Anniversary of the Adoption of the Declaration on the Right to Development.' Participants exchanged views on concepts and practices of the right to development and practical cooperation for shared development.

title: 融通山海  共赴未来 兴业银行以金融之力服务高质量共建“一带一路”
title_en: Connecting Mountains and Seas, Pursuing a Shared Future: Industrial Bank Supports High-Quality Belt and Road Cooperation with Financial Strength
summary: 兴业银行从设施联通、绿色丝路、产业合作、民心相通等方面服务高质量共建“一带一路”。该行累计为中欧班列“长安号”提供超14亿元资金，参与坦桑尼亚中央线标轨铁路15年期银团融资，支持哈萨克斯坦和阿根廷清洁能源项目，并为印尼镍钴冶炼、沙特铝产业园
summary_en: Industrial Bank supports high-quality Belt and Road cooperation in infrastructure connectivity, green Silk Road, industrial cooperation and people-to-people bonds. It has provided over 1.4 billion yuan for the China-Europe Railway Express 'Chang'an,' participated in a 15-year syndicated loan for Tanzania's central line standard-gauge railway, supported clean energy projects in Kazakhstan and Argentina, and assisted nickel-cobalt smelting in Indonesia and the Saudi aluminum industrial park.

title: 用双脚丈量长征（阅见世界）
title_en: Measuring the Long March on Foot (Reading the World)
summary: 本文记述美国作家索尔兹伯里重走长征路并撰写长征著作的经过。他等待数十年终获准采访，在金沙江皎平渡坚持徒步15公里，途中心脏病发作仍继续行程，其心脏起搏器后被中国军事博物馆收藏。登泸定桥时，他留言盛赞红军壮举。该书成为海外长征书写代表作，基于
summary_en: This article recounts how American writer Harrison Salisbury retraced the Long March and wrote a book about it. After waiting decades for permission, he insisted on walking 15 kilometers at Jiaopingdu on the Jinsha River, continued despite a heart attack, and his pacemaker was later collected by the Military Museum of China. At Luding Bridge, he left a message praising the Red Army's feat. The book became a representative overseas account of the Long March.

summary: 11月2日至5日，“2026世界市长对话·宁波”在浙江宁波举办。3日主活动中，中外市长围绕“开放融通·共生机遇”主题，就特色优势与城市国际化、开放合作与城市发展、人文交流与民心相通等议题对话。活动包括一场主活动、两场情景对话、三场文明交流互
summary_en: From November 2 to 5, the 2026 World Mayors Dialogue · Ningbo was held in Ningbo, Zhejiang. At the main event on November 3, Chinese and foreign mayors discussed distinctive advantages and urban internationalization, open cooperation and urban development, and people-to-people exchanges under the theme 'Open Connectivity · Shared Opportunities'. The program included one main session, two scenario dialogues, and three cultural exchange sessions.

title: 中国文旅全新亮相伦敦世界旅游交易会
title_en: China's culture and tourism makes new debut at World Travel Market London
summary: 中国文旅亮相伦敦世界旅游交易会，中国展区以“中国旅游：文塑旅彰，智创未来，绿色共生”为主题，总面积487.5平方米，规模创历届新高，共有14个省区市、116家机构和企业参展。中国驻伦敦旅游办事处主任张力表示，旅游是文化探寻和增进民心相通的重
summary_en: China's culture and tourism was showcased at the World Travel Market London. The China pavilion, themed 'China Tourism: Culture Shapes Tourism, Intelligence Creates the Future, Green Coexistence,' covered 487.5 square meters, a record size, and hosted 14 provinces, regions and cities and 116 institutions and enterprises. Zhang Li, director of the China National Tourist Office in London, said tourism is an important way to explore culture and enhance people-to-people bonds.

title: 秉持多边共治理念  共护外空和平安宁
title_en: Uphold multilateral co-governance, jointly safeguard peace and tranquility in outer space
summary: 文章介绍中方在2026全球治理论坛（雄安）上提出《关于加强外空治理的中国立场》，旨在落实四大全球倡议，推动外空领域构建人类命运共同体。文件倡导外空发展与安全、稳定与可持续并重，秉持依规有序、全面综合、利益均衡、自我克制原则，并提出“三个坚持
summary_en: The article says China proposed 'China's Position on Strengthening Outer Space Governance' at the 2026 Global Governance Forum (Xiong'an), aiming to implement the four global initiatives and build a community with a shared future for mankind in outer space. The document advocates giving equal importance to development and security, stability and sustainability in outer space, following the principles of rule-based order, comprehensiveness, balanced interests and self-restraint, and puts forward 'three commitments'.

title: “赓续长征精神  奋进复兴征程——记者再走长征路”主题采访活动圆满结束
title_en: Themed reporting activity 'Carry forward the Long March spirit, forge ahead on the journey of rejuvenation—reporters retrace the Long March' concludes successfully
summary: 由中央宣传部组织开展的“赓续长征精神 奋进复兴征程——记者再走长征路”主题采访活动历时一个多月圆满结束。采访中，记者见证老区新变化，接受长征精神洗礼。江西瑞金至陕西延安高铁实现首次直达，开行首月发送旅客12.2万人次；湖南怀化依托国际陆港常
summary_en: The month-long themed interview activity 'Carrying Forward the Long March Spirit, Forging Ahead on the Journey to Rejuvenation — Journalists Retrace the Long March,' organized by the Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee, concluded successfully. Journalists witnessed new changes in old revolutionary base areas and were inspired by the Long March spirit. The high-speed rail from Ruijin in Jiangxi to Yan'an in Shaanxi achieved direct service for the first time, carrying 122,000 passengers in its first month; Huaihua in Hunan, leveraging its international land port, has regularly launched international freight services.

title: 王毅会见朝鲜劳动党代表团
title_en: Wang Yi Meets Delegation of the Workers' Party of Korea
summary: 11月5日，中共中央政治局委员、中央外办主任王毅在北京会见由朝鲜劳动党中央政治局委员、中央书记、国际部部长金成男率领的朝鲜劳动党代表团。王毅表示，习近平总书记今年6月成功对朝鲜进行国事访问，为新时期中朝关系发展指明前进方向；中方愿同朝方共同
summary_en: On November 5, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and director of the Office of the Central Foreign Affairs Commission, met in Beijing with a Workers' Party of Korea delegation led by Kim Song Nam, member of the Political Bureau, secretary of the Central Committee and head of the International Department of the WPK Central Committee. Wang Yi said General Secretary Xi Jinping's successful state visit to the DPRK in June charted the course for China-DPRK relations in the new era; China is willing to work with the DPRK.

title: 推动科技创新和产业创新深度融合  金正大助力千人赴德开展农业研学
title_en: Promoting Deep Integration of Technological and Industrial Innovation; Kingenta Supports 1,000 People on Agricultural Study Tour to Germany
summary: 10月20日，中德农业科技与产业融合交流会暨德国农业深度研学计划启动仪式在北京举行，由金正大承办，中德科研机构、行业组织及种植经营主体等150余人参加。金正大作为全球缓控释肥行业引领者，掌握112项缓控释肥发明专利，主持参与26项国际、国家
summary_en: On October 20, the China-Germany Agricultural Technology and Industrial Integration Exchange Meeting and the launch ceremony of the German Agriculture In-depth Study Program were held in Beijing, hosted by Kingenta, with over 150 participants from Chinese and German research institutions, industry organizations and planting operators. As a global leader in controlled-release fertilizers, Kingenta holds 112 invention patents for controlled-release fertilizers and has led or participated in 26 international and national standards.

summary: 阿富汗卡迪尔·拉尔夫有限公司连续参加中国国际进口博览会，是进博会“全勤生”。公司负责人哈默德·拉尔夫介绍，受益于中方给予阿富汗100%税目产品零关税待遇和进博会平台，阿富汗手工地毯在中国市场销量快速增长，公司营业额自首届进博会以来增长近70
summary_en: Afghanistan's Qadir Ralf Ltd. has attended every China International Import Expo, making it a 'full-attendance' exhibitor. summary_en: During the CIIE, Yihai Kerry Arawana displayed new products such as diacylglycerol oil, grain and miscellaneous grain rice balls, and Shuxin vinegar, aligning with the healthy consumption trend and building a health product matrix. title: 共同擘画新时代中多命运共同体的美好蓝图（大使随笔）
title_en: Jointly drawing a beautiful blueprint for a China-Togo community with a shared future in the new era (Ambassador's Journal)
summary: 10月，习近平主席在北京会见多哥部长会议主席福雷，双方宣布将双边关系定位提升为新时代中多命运共同体，发表联合声明并签署15项合作协议。建交54年来，中多始终相互尊重、团结协作，多哥坚定恪守一个中国原则，支持人类命运共同体理念和全球倡议。习近
summary_en: In October, President Xi Jinping met with Togo's Prime Minister Faure in Beijing. The two sides announced the elevation of bilateral relations to a China-Togo community with a shared future in the new era, issued a joint statement, and signed 15 cooperation agreements. Over 54 years of diplomatic relations, China and Togo have always respected each other and worked together; Togo firmly adheres to the One-China principle and supports the concept of a community with a shared future for mankind and global initiatives.

title_en: 11th Lancang-Mekong Cooperation Foreign Ministers' Meeting held in Beijing

summary_en: The 11th Lancang-Mekong Cooperation Foreign Ministers' Meeting was held in Beijing. Wang Yi said this year marks the 10th anniversary of the first Lancang-Mekong Cooperation Leaders' Meeting; over the past decade, the cooperation has become a 'golden model' of regional cooperation, benefiting people in the six countries and supporting their modernization. The parties will advance Lancang-Mekong Cooperation 2.0 and open a new 'golden decade.' Wang Yi proposed unity and self-strengthening, openness and win-win cooperation.
